## StreamDek Mobile v0.1.2

This release focuses on home screen customization, cleaner settings flows, better stream result presentation, and faster, more reliable playback behavior.

### What's New

- Dedicated settings pages for `Catalog & Home Layout`, `Continue Watching`, and `Page Style`, replacing the older inline drawer and picker flows.
- A boxed, scrollable Catalog layout editor with improved spacing above the floating navigation and a cleaner sectioned presentation.
- Built-in app catalogs now support a master on/off toggle plus a single-provider choice between Cinemeta and TMDB.
- Default home rows are now clearly labeled with an `SD -` prefix, and provider-specific rows refresh correctly when switching between Cinemeta and TMDB.
- Continue Watching settings now use a standalone visual card selector with improved layout and restored styling.
- Page Style now has its own dedicated screen with larger, more recognizable home-style preview cards.
- Addons settings now display addon logos more reliably and show each addon URL beneath its description.
- Stream results in the mobile app now preserve addon-provided formatting instead of reformatting the text in-app.
- StreamDek Ultra result formatting has been improved to better match the richer, structured visual style used in the latest design.
- Fusion badges have been restored across stream result views, including main result lists and in-player source selection sheets.
- Home and browse surfaces have been updated to keep network rows and built-in catalog rows loading correctly after provider and layout changes.
- Stream ranking now pushes actively cached debrid results to the top before other scoring rules are applied.
- Live channel playback startup has been tuned to begin faster with lower initial playback buffering.
- Movie replay is more reliable again: StreamDek now remembers and reselects the last working source more consistently when replaying a title.

### Highlights

This update significantly improves how users personalize the home experience. Home layout editing is now easier to understand, built-in catalogs are more controlled, and key visual settings each have their own focused page instead of being crowded into shared drawers.

Playback and stream usability also received meaningful upgrades. Stream rows now respect provider formatting, Fusion badges are visible again, live channels start faster, and replaying a movie is better at returning to the last source that actually worked.

### Notes

- This release includes all mobile app updates completed over the last three days, including the latest stream replay reliability fix.
- The Android release APK and update manifest will be published automatically by the GitHub release workflow after the `v0.1.2` tag is pushed.
